definitions.explanation: The middle portion of a calendar month, roughly the 10th to 20th. Combines {月|つき} ("month") with {半|なか}ば ("middle, halfway point"). Used both as a time expression in itself and to anchor schedules: "by mid-month," "around the middle of the month," etc.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{半|なか}ばに{払|はら}う。
examples.english: I'll pay in the middle of the month.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}は{月|つき}{半|なか}ばまでに{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the report by the middle of the month.

examples.japanese: {月初|つきはじ}めは{忙|いそが}しいので、{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせは{月|つき}{半|なか}ばあたりにしましょう。
examples.english: The beginning of the month is busy, so let's set the meeting for around mid-month.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{半|なか}ばを{過|す}ぎると、{月末|げつまつ}{締切|しめきり}の{仕事|しごと}が{気|き}になり{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Once we get past the middle of the month, I start worrying about the end-of-month deadlines.

notes:
{月|つき}{半|なか}ば is a fairly common time expression for the middle stretch of a calendar month. The {半|なか}ば element is the same word that appears in many "middle of X" expressions: {年|とし}{半|なか}ば ("middle of the year"), {道|みち}{半|なか}ば ("halfway along the road / partway done").

FORMS:
- {月|つき} ("month") + {半|なか}ば ("middle, midway point") → {月|つき}{半|なか}ば

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ばに: in mid-month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ばまでに: by mid-month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ばを{過|す}ぎる: to pass the middle of the month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ばあたり: around mid-month
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば{頃|ごろ}: roughly mid-month

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {月初|つきはじ}め / {月初|げっしょ}: beginning of the month
- {月末|げつまつ}: end of the month
- {中旬|ちゅうじゅん}: middle ten days of the month (a more formal/precise term, used in news and documents)
- {上旬|じょうじゅん}: first ten days of the month
- {下旬|げじゅん}: last ten days of the month
- {年|とし}{半|なか}ば: middle of the year

USAGE:
- {月|つき}{半|なか}ば is conversational and slightly soft compared to {中旬|ちゅうじゅん}, which is more precise and used in business writing, schedules, and weather forecasts. "6{月|がつ}{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}" is the natural way to write "mid-June" in a printed schedule, while "{月|つき}{半|なか}ば" is more typical in speech.
- {半|なか}ば can also be used as a noun on its own meaning "halfway, in the middle of doing," as in {仕事|しごと}{半|なか}ばで{帰|かえ}る ("to leave with the work half-done").
